matching_rule: Exactly one specification for every planned document ID in source-document-register.json; no extra IDs.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Crown Court working case summary: restricted cover, document control, allegation/status warning, parties, non-operative proposed charges, neutral chronology, issues by count, evidence map, application/hearing table and unresolved actions. It orients reviewers without converting an allegation into a fact.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 12-18 pages; 300-500 substantive words on narrative pages and 10-22 sourced chronology rows per table page; short cover/control pages are legitimate.
required_fields_headings_and_provenance: source ID and locator for each factual proposition
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital accessible PDF planned from a controlled word-processing source; selectable text, tagged headings, repeated table headers and stable internal links; no scanned summary.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Tracked v0.1/v0.2 review changes, genuinely unresolved fields, one clearly superseded chronology entry retained in history and ordinary non-uniform paragraph lengths; no fake typos added for realism.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Restricted criminal-case material. Solicitor/CPS/internal versions may show source map; defendant-client version omits unnecessary complainant medical, counselling and contact detail; court version contains only authorised material and anonymity-safe identifiers.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated allegation narrative, copied witness statements, generic law extracts, decorative evidence tables, duplicated chronology or blank spacer pages.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: charge-status banner visible on every relevant page
each chronology row has a source
no allegation written as finding
table headers repeat and do not clip
links and page references resolve
client/court redaction variants compare cleanly
no orphan pseudonym or real-person identifier

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: First-account section containing statement cover sheets, signed/dated witness accounts, 999 and BWV exhibit/media registers, event-to-recording chronology, officer continuity statements, transcript extracts and gap log. It preserves speaker, source and account evolution.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 18-28 pages; witness statements 250-450 words/page, media register 8-20 items/page and transcript extracts 35-70 timed turns/page depending on turn length.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed signed scans and born-digital registers; ordinary audio/video remains external with a media index, thumbnails only where justified, and time-coded human-readable transcript aids. Scans may contain genuine handwriting and seals but remain legible.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Natural pauses, inaudible passages, a late officer correction and a transcript revision are allowed when explicitly versioned; minor scan skew or shadow is acceptable if content remains readable and no fact changes silently.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Complainant identity/contact, home interior and third-party voices restricted. Defendant/client outputs receive only authorised relevant extracts; media access follows court/prosecution controls; redaction reasons and unredacted custodian are logged.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No full transcript duplicated beside every clip, repeated thumbnails, invented continuity forms, repeated boilerplate declarations or unused empty media-register rows.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: media duration reconciles with register and transcript
speaker label is not treated as verified identity without source
first account remains distinct from later ABE
scan signatures/dates are visible or explicitly redacted
thumbnail aspect ratio is correct
timecode sequence and timezone are consistent
redactions do not reveal text through selectable layers

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Controlled ABE suite: recording master record, working-copy record, access log, interview plan/context, full timed transcript, accessibility captions register, proposed edit schedule, objections/decisions and playback index. It supports evidence-in-chief preparation while keeping each derivative distinct.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 45-60 pages; transcript normally 30-65 timed speaker turns/page; registers 8-18 entries/page; edit schedule 6-15 reasoned segments/page. Density follows actual interview duration rather than a page quota.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Video master remains native media; no embedding into a generated PDF. Transcript, captions, access log and edit schedule are born-digital accessible records. Still images are exceptional, source-timecoded and never substitutes for playback.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Natural hesitation, overlap, non-verbal responses, inaudible portions, caption/transcript disagreement and proposed-versus-approved edit versions are preserved. Corrections require a new version and change note; the master is immutable.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Highly restricted special-measures recording. Access is named, timed and purpose-limited; defendant-client copy/export/API cannot expose the recording or unnecessary intimate content; court playback follows the operative direction; internal scorer access is controlled.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated transcript blocks, decorative frame grabs, fabricated question-and-answer turns, duplicate captions, empty access rows or expansion of pauses into artificial pages.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: master/working/clip hashes and lineage reconcile
transcript/captions align to sampled audio timecodes
non-verbal and inaudible markers retained
edit segments do not overlap accidentally
proposed edits are not shown as approved
speaker headings and page breaks do not obscure questions/answers
access restrictions hold across all exits
no translation label applied to transcript or captions

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Focused SARC/medical bundle with clinical cover/index, consent and examination context, contemporaneous clinical notes, body-map or image register where justified, laboratory/result records, clinician statement, expert report/limitations and addendum history. It records clinical evidence without deciding consent or guilt.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 25-38 pages; clinical forms retain legitimate whitespace, notes average 180-400 words/page, result tables 8-20 rows/page and any body map uses one clear annotated figure/page when necessary.
required_fields_headings_and_provenance: source of history distinguished from observation
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed authentic-looking scanned clinical forms, born-digital results and expert PDF; colour only where clinically necessary; source images separately controlled with calibrated scale/metadata, not casually embedded.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Clinical abbreviations, contemporaneous corrections initialled/dated, a genuinely illegible word marked as such and later expert addendum are permitted. Earlier opinions remain visible; no retrospective clean-up may change the record.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Special-category medical data. Only proportionate relevant material is served; unrelated history, addresses and third-party data are redacted with reasons. Client output summarises authorised relevance without reproducing intimate detail; court use is ruling-dependent.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No invented medical history, repeated normal findings, decorative body maps, duplicated result tables, generic textbook material or blank form pages without evidential purpose.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: history and clinical observation visually separated
dates/times/sample IDs reconcile with continuity
units and reference values present where needed
body-map labels and scale legible
redaction does not hide provenance needed for challenge
expert limitations and version are prominent
no medical proposition is expressed as legal consent/guilt conclusion

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Phone-extraction report and selected communications schedule: acquisition summary, device/account/person distinction, scope and filtering method, conversation index, chronological message/call tables, attachment references, deletion/gap notes and analyst limitations.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 25-35 pages; 10-24 meaningful communications rows/page, 250-450 words/page for methodology and no more than four necessary thumbnails/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native extraction remains external; born-digital searchable schedule with monospace identifiers and legible wrapping; screenshots are secondary visual aids linked to native records and may show ordinary handset scaling/cropping.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Missing attachments, duplicate platform events, timezone correction, truncated preview and later expanded selection are allowed when explicitly logged/versioned; display-name changes are preserved.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Intimate and unrelated third-party communications minimised. Full extraction access is solicitor/CPS/internal controlled; client/court receive authorised selections with redaction log and stable locators.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated screenshots of scheduled text, irrelevant chat runs, one-message-per-page layouts, duplicated quoted chains or invented metadata.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: chronology sort and timezone conversion verified
long messages wrap without clipping
native locator resolves for sampled rows
display name is not rendered as verified person
attachment icons/IDs match register
redactions do not alter meaning silently
selection totals and gaps reconcile
no cross-matter conversation appears

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Third-party material workflow: scoped request, legal/relevance rationale, provider response, material index, refusal/partial-response state, viewing log, reviewer notes, disclosure decision and redaction/minimisation schedule. It proves process, not entitlement or admissibility.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 20-30 pages; requests/responses 250-450 words/page, indexes 10-25 items/page and viewing logs 8-18 review events/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital letters/forms and secure viewing logs; received records described by index rather than reproduced wholesale; signed scanned responses acceptable with legible date and author.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Narrowed request, delayed or partial response, duplicate provider numbering and corrected viewing log are legitimate if preserved with audit history; missing material remains explicit.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Highly sensitive counselling/medical/third-party material. Access limited by role and recorded; only material meeting the applicable disclosure decision is served; client/court versions exclude collateral intimate data.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No bulk reproduction of third-party records, generic privacy notices repeated per item, invented review notes, duplicate request letters or empty log rows.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: request scope matches response index
every viewed item has viewer/date/purpose
partial/refused state is conspicuous
decision and service are not conflated
redaction reasons are reviewable
sensitive material does not leak through bookmarks/metadata
page ranges and provider IDs reconcile

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Suspect interview and defence-position section: custody/interview cover, participant and caution/legal-advice record, audio exhibit/index, timed transcript, significant statements/silences if properly identified, defence statement and version/service history.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 20-28 pages; transcript 35-75 turns/page and defence statement 300-500 words/page; cover and signature pages may be sparse for authentic reasons.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native audio external with born-digital transcript; signed defence statement may be scanned; typed continuation sheets retain page numbering and maker initials where professionally expected.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Natural overlap, pauses, inaudible words, interview breaks and a later corrected transcript are allowed. Draft and signed defence statements remain separate and neither silently supersedes source audio.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Own-defence material is solicitor/client controlled; privileged attendance notes or advice never enter this section; CPS/court receive only served defence statement and authorised interview material.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No invented answers, repeated caution text on every page, duplicated transcript excerpts, blank continuation pages or generic defence submissions.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: audio duration and transcript endpoints reconcile
speaker labels remain maker-specific
interview account not merged with defence statement
draft/signed/service status visible
signatures and page numbering present or explicitly absent
no privileged advice included
citation to interview timecode works

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Procedural application bundle: special-measures assessment and application, confidential supplement, response and direction; section 41 request/application/response/ruling; witness-availability evidence and arrangements; hearing notices, orders and action log. It keeps proposal, filing, hearing and ruling distinct.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 25-38 pages; forms retain authentic field density, applications 250-500 words/page, orders 150-350 words/page and procedural tables 8-18 events/page.
required_fields_headings_and_provenance: rule/statutory basis marked pending review where necessary
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital current-form-style applications and orders; signed/scanned availability evidence where justified; confidential supplement separated from open bundle with clear access label.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Draft revised after response, adjourned hearing, partial grant/refusal and changing availability are legitimate only with dated versions. Superseded notices remain auditable but visually marked.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Confidential special-measures details excluded from defendant-client and open-court outputs unless authorised. Section 41 and medical/intimate assertions are purpose-limited; court order controls permitted use.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied generic legal tests, duplicate blank forms, repeated witness biography, fabricated ruling reasons or extra hearing notices solely to add pages.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: draft/filed/heard/ruling labels unmistakable
confidential supplement cannot appear in open export
operative order distinguished from superseded notice
requested and granted measures compare correctly
section 41 request is not presented as permission
availability date/source present
form fields and signatures do not clip

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Trial-preparation and disclosure section: MG6-style indexes/schedules, disclosure officer report and decisions, defence requests/responses, later-service log, expert/counsel extracts where relied upon, witness/media checklist and trial-readiness action table.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 20-30 pages; schedules 10-25 substantive rows/page, advice/extracts 300-550 words/page and action tables 8-20 rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital searchable schedules with stable row IDs and filters represented safely in human-readable form; signed reports/extracts may be scanned; native spreadsheets are not the primary rank-6 format.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Late-added item, corrected item description, superseded schedule and outstanding action are legitimate when versioned; deleted rows are never silently removed.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Sensitive schedules, internal review and counsel advice are audience-limited; privileged defence advice has zero leakage to CPS/court; client receives an appropriate summary rather than internal risk notes.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No boilerplate schedule rows, repeated item descriptions, full duplicate statements, generic counsel text, artificial empty rows or reprinting the same index in multiple styles.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: unique stable item IDs
row descriptions do not reveal protected content improperly
decision/service dates and actors present
superseded/current schedule visibly distinguished
expert limitations retained
privilege and sensitivity filters tested across exits
trial checklist reconciles with source register
no hidden rows or clipped columns
